name: hooks-wiring
title: Five hook events, each a shell script
part: What it costs, and how it was built
html:
Five hook events, each a shell script

// core/hooks.json (abridged)
"PreToolUse": [
  { "matcher": "*",
    …/protect-gate.sh },
  { "matcher": "Edit|Write|MultiEdit",
    …/gherkin-first.sh },
  { "matcher": "Bash",
    …/gate-bash.sh } ],
"PostToolUse": [
  { "matcher": "Edit|Write|MultiEdit",
    …/log-event.sh, …/lint.sh } ],
"Stop": [
  …/check.sh  (timeout 600) ],
"UserPromptSubmit": [
  …/refactor-prompt.sh ]

hooks.json

Exit 2 blocks the call and hands stderr to the model.

Blocked in this very session, word for word:

Blocked: this command reaches the
TDD gate or refactor mode.

Blocked: run tests through
.claude/bdd-gates/bdd-run.sh [extra
args] so the BDD_RUN result is logged.

The second stopped a raw test run that would have left no BDD_RUN line in the log.
say: core/hooks.json, merged into .claude/settings.json by install.sh. protect-gate runs before every tool; gherkin-first before every edit; gate-bash before every shell command; log-event and lint after every edit; check.sh when the model tries to stop. Exit code 2 blocks the call and sends stderr back to the model.
